metadata.name: pactyra_core
metadata.description: Core protocol for evidence-bound economic authority

instructions.name: assert_capability
docs: Assert that a capability is valid for the requested action.
This is the core enforcement instruction with all security checks.

accounts.name: delegate_scope
docs: Optional: if a delegate (session key) is signing instead of the authority root,
this account must be provided and the delegate scope is verified.

instructions.name: cancel_operation
docs: Cancel a proposed timelocked operation (only proposer can cancel).

instructions.name: close_receipt
docs: Close a receipt account and reclaim rent.
Only the agent's authority root can close receipts.
Receipts can only be closed after the authority epoch has advanced
(ensuring they are historical, not active evidence).

instructions.name: create_policy
docs: Create a new policy. Policies are immutable once created.

instructions.name: delegate_authority
docs: Grant a delegate (session key) with bounded scope.

instructions.name: deprecate_verifier
docs: Deprecate a verifier — marks it as inactive in the registry.

instructions.name: execute_operation
docs: Execute a timelocked operation after the delay has passed.

instructions.name: freeze_agent
docs: Freeze an agent — prevents all future capability assertions.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialize the protocol with a verifier registry.

instructions.name: lock_bond
docs: Lock a bond for an agent.
Tracks the bond amount in the Agent and Bond accounts.
Can be called again to re-lock after a slash.

instructions.name: propose_operation
docs: Propose a timelocked trust-root operation.
The operation can only be executed after TIMELOCK_DELAY_SECONDS.

instructions.name: record_outcome
docs: Record a performance outcome from a registered verifier.
Updates agent counters and triggers authority transitions.
Security: The verifier cannot fabricate the outcome because the
evidence_hash must match the keccak256 of the Pyth price update
account data. An independent observer can re-verify the hash.

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register a new agent. The signer becomes the authority root.

instructions.name: register_verifier
docs: Register a verifier in the registry.
Only the protocol authority can call this.

instructions.name: replace_protocol_authority
docs: Replace the protocol authority — transfers control of the VerifierRegistry.

instructions.name: request_capability
docs: Request a capability for an agent.

instructions.name: revoke_capability
docs: Revoke a capability. Only the agent's authority root can call this.

instructions.name: revoke_delegate
docs: Revoke a delegate (session key).

instructions.name: supersede_policy
docs: Supersede a policy — marks it as superseded and points to the new policy.

instructions.name: unfreeze_agent
docs: Unfreeze an agent — restores active status.
